services.name: Fall 2026 Field Trips
services.desc: Help your students discover that art is more than something we look at-it's a way of seeing, thinking, and telling stories. During this interactive STEAM + LIT field trip, students will explore abstract landscapes by featured artist Winter Rusiloski, compare them with East Texas scenes created by members of the Lufkin Art Guild, explore community with Emmi Hasselbach and celebrate the Museum of East Texas's 50-year history. Through guided discussions, students will strengthen observation, critical thinking, and communication skills while making connections between visual art, local history, science, mathematics, and language arts.
